opening.argument: The video shows how to buy Bitcoin at an ATM in Hawaii. The creator says, “I did this just to show you how it works,” and describes paying about fifteen percent extra to complete the transaction. A person holds a phone displaying a QR code in front of the ATM interface, reinforcing that the focus is the purchase process. The conversation with a person the creator meets there covers that person's own Bitcoin use, holding and mining, as well as how Bitcoin can be used in transactions. Although the description includes a website and voluntary donation addresses, it states no promised benefit or deceptive condition. The video presents no specific deceptive offer and does not ask viewers to invest or send money to the creator.
